newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Nizhnevartovskneftegaz to issue shares.
newsitem.headline: Russian Nizhnevartovskneftegaz to issue shares.

text.p: Russian oil company Nizhnevartovskneftegaz will issue 1.0 billion new shares, it said in a statement on Thursday.

The company also said that it would increase its authorised but unissued capital by 2.1 trillion roubles. It was not immediately clear whether the shares would be issued from the company's increased capital or original capital.
The statement said that the board of directors had decided to issue around 753 million ordinary shares and around 249 million preferred shares.
Nizhnevartovskneftegaz's current authorised capital is 18.22 billion roubles.
It is not unusual for Russian companies to revalue their capital by a hundredfold.
The company has approved an increase in authorised but unissued shares of about 1.85 billion ordinary shares and 249 million preferred shares, each with a nominal value of 1,000 roubles.
